privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: At ChefFlow we value your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over your personal information.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: We only collect the information needed to make the service work:

points.account: Account data: name and email to create and manage your session
points.recipes: Recipes and ingredients you create or save yourself
points.planning: Weekly plans and shopping lists you generate in the app
points.usage: Basic technical data (device type, language) to keep the service stable

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.content: Your data is used solely to deliver the service: authenticating you, showing your recipes and plans, and improving the experience inside ChefFlow.
dataUse.noCommercial: We do not use your data for commercial purposes. We do not sell, rent, or transfer it to third parties for advertising or marketing.

dataSharing.title: Sharing with Third Parties
dataSharing.content: We do not share your personal data with third parties, except when strictly necessary for the operation of the service (for example, hosting providers) or when required by law. These providers act as data processors and are bound by confidentiality obligations.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We keep your information while your account is active. If you delete your account, we permanently remove your personal data and associated resources (recipes, plans, lists), except for what we must keep due to legal obligations.

security.title: Security
security.content: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information: encryption in transit (HTTPS), secure password storage, and database access control. No system is 100% secure, but we work to minimize risks.

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.content: We use cookies and local storage only to keep you logged in and remember basic preferences (such as language). We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: Under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR in the European Union), you have the following rights over your personal data:

points.access: Access: request a copy of the data we hold about you
points.rectification: Rectification: correct any incorrect or outdated information
points.deletion: Erasure: ask us to delete your account and all your data
points.portability: Portability: receive your data in a structured, readable format

userRights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, write to us at
userRights.contactSuffix: and we will respond within 30 days.

children.title: Minors
children.content: ChefFlow is not intended for children under 14. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this Policy
changes.content: We may update this policy to reflect changes in the service or in regulations. If the changes are significant, we will notify you by email or within the app before they take effect.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this policy or the processing of your data, contact us at

privacy.footer: Your privacy matters. Thank you for trusting ChefFlow.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using ChefFlow, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our service.

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.content: We collect and use your data solely to provide and improve ChefFlow services:

points.personal: Personal information (name, email) for account management
points.recipes: Your recipes and meal plans for service functionality
points.planning: Usage patterns to improve user experience
points.improvement: Aggregated, anonymous data for service improvements

dataUse.noCommercial: We will never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data at any time. If you wish to delete your account and all associated data, please contact us at
userRights.contactSuffix: and we will process your request within 30 days.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to enhance your experience, keep you logged in, and analyze service usage. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these terms occasionally. We will notify users of significant changes via email or through our service.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about these terms, please contact us at
